text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
I'd like to express my gratitude to you once again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you—
for the other day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the shadows over the path I must take have vanished.
I was able to stand back up on my own two feet once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have no blind spots left anymore.
Besides..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"There is no race more fitting
for the reborn 'Emperor' to run."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Today, into the traditions that so many have run through,
I shall carve my name as well.
